audience.text: Developers needing fast, non-blocking image format detection and metadata extraction without full decoding, especially in web or batch processing pipelines.

capabilities.text: Detects 14 image formats by reading only signature bytes using `ImageProbe.DetectFormat()` without decoding pixels.
capabilities.title: Format detection

capabilities.text: Reads width, height, bit depth, and frame count directly from file headers for PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, WEBP, ICO, TIFF, PSD, EMF, WMF, DICOM, DJVU, AVIF, and HEIC/HEIF.
capabilities.title: Header probing

capabilities.text: Accurately counts frames in GIF, ICO, TIFF, and multi-page DJVU by walking their container structures.
capabilities.title: Multi-frame counting

capabilities.text: Provides both synchronous and asynchronous entry points (`ProbeFile`/`ProbeFileAsync`, `Probe`/`ProbeAsync`) for non-blocking I/O.
capabilities.title: Async support

capabilities.text: Returns partial `ImageInfo` with only `Format` set for malformed or truncated files instead of throwing exceptions.
capabilities.title: Robust error handling

capabilities.text: No external NuGet package dependencies; all format parsing is implemented natively within the library.
capabilities.title: Zero dependencies

limitations.text: Only performs format detection and header probing; does not decode, render, edit, or convert pixel data.
Frame count is only real for GIF, ICO, TIFF, and multi-page DJVU; other formats report fixed `1`.
Classic (non-placeable) WMF headers lack bounding rectangle, so `Width`/`Height` are null for them.
DICOM parsing stops at the first undefined-length element, such as a sequence or encapsulated pixel data.
CDR format support is planned but not yet implemented; no handler exists in the current source tree.

problems_solved.text: Avoids full image decoding just to determine format and basic properties like dimensions, bit depth, and frame count.
Provides format support for less common .NET imaging formats like PSD, EMF/WMF, DICOM, DJVU, AVIF, and HEIC/HEIF without external dependencies.
Enables safe, unattended processing of untrusted files by returning partial results instead of throwing exceptions on malformed headers.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Imaging.Foss is a free, open-source .NET library for image format detection and header probing with zero dependencies.

uncertainties: The exact set of DICOM transfer syntaxes supported beyond Implicit VR LE and Explicit VR LE/BLE is not fully specified.
Whether AVIF grid images report tile or full-canvas dimensions depends on `ispe`/`ipma`/`ipco` associations, but exact behavior for edge cases is unclear.
The behavior of `Probe()` on streams with partial or corrupted data beyond signature match is not detailed for all formats.
The scope of `ImageProbe`'s async behavior under high concurrency or with cancellation tokens is not elaborated.
The exact handling of truncated multi-frame formats (e.g., GIF with incomplete image descriptors) is not fully described.
Whether `Probe()` buffers non-seekable streams fully or uses streaming techniques is implied but not explicit.
The versioning scheme and release frequency for the package are not stated.
The exact set of formats for which `FrameCount` is `null` (e.g., indirect DJVM) is not exhaustively listed.

workflows.name: Build and test
workflows.text: Clone the repository and run `dotnet build Aspose.Imaging.Foss.sln` followed by `dotnet test Aspose.Imaging.Foss.sln` to validate functionality.

workflows.name: CI validation
workflows.text: Continuous integration runs on Ubuntu and Windows using workflows defined in `.github/workflows/`.

workflows.name: Release publishing
workflows.text: Tagged pushes trigger `.github/workflows/release.yml` to build and publish the package.
